svg.desc: Editable source for the B2S backglass. Replace the wordmark placeholder with the CyQuantiFi wordmark file. Keep the MITRE ATT&CK attribution.
svg.text: PUT A DOLLAR FIGURE ON EVERY CYBER RISK
Technique names from MITRE ATT&CK® (attack.mitre.org). Dollar values are game-design numbers, not loss estimates.
